    The projective corner of the lifted modules is B (toward Corollary 12.1) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: "At projective labels choose the regular B-projectives." The vertex idempotents e_p of A₀ give vertices of the length grading (vxIdem), and a splitting of B respecting them (Lemma 6.4). The lift M_p^B at a projective label is the regular module φ(e_p) B (Proposition 6.5(3)), by uniqueness of lifts; the corner algebra of the lifted modules at the projective labels is therefore B (cornerEquiv).
